'''Mario Tarin''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 6th (I think) at [[February 2001 Madrid tournament]] on 24 February 2001, according to Angel San Jose's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1776">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-24-ithor-madrid-spain-feb-24-2001d1776/ ithor-madrid-spain-feb-24-2001], DeckTech (Angel "Dj" San Jose, 24 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-24-ithor-madrid-spain-feb-24-2001d1776/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
